invizible.execution: future embedded modules OR explicitly configured proxy-only companion; not a second VPN

tor.scope: selected TCP applications via local routing engine

dnscrypt.egress: direct encrypted DNS; resolver can observe queries

decisions.name: singleVpnOwner
decisions.rationale: Android has one active VPN service per user/profile. Provider choices are alternatives, not simultaneous apps.

decisions.name: killSwitch
decisions.rationale: Always-on and block-without-VPN require OS/user configuration and device failure-path tests. Do not set this planner as always-on.

decisions.name: ipv6
decisions.rationale: Omitting IPv6 routes alone is not leak protection. Capture ::/0 and carry or explicitly block unsupported IPv6 in a real engine.

decisions.name: dns
decisions.rationale: DNS forwarding, bootstrap, .onion/.i2p separation and no-fallback policy need an implemented and tested packet path.

decisions.name: mtu
decisions.rationale: No universal MTU/MSS optimization is assumed. Measure the actual transport and mobile path.

warnings: PLAN ONLY: no tunnel engines, routing, DNS protection or kill switch are active in this scaffold.
